summary: ETL developer with about 6 years of data warehouse experience, working as a DataStage developer and production support analyst across banking and credit card data programmes. Builds and migrates IBM DataStage jobs (versions 8.5, 9.1 and 11.5) for ETL and ELT on DB2, Netezza, Oracle, SQL Server and Hadoop Hive platforms, with source-to-target mapping and dimensional fact and dimension loads. Migrated over 100 TB to Netezza, converted 180 Informatica mappings to DataStage, and moved 1000+ jobs between server versions. Leads offshore and nearshore teams, gathers requirements, and handles release, defect tracking and production support for mid-level to large business intelligence applications.
